instruction: Using only the visible website interfaces, open the Releases page of the Microsoft Playwright GitHub repository and identify the newest non-preview release. Report its exact release tag, publication date, and three concrete changes from that release notes. Then verify one of those same three changes using official Playwright documentation. For the accessibility snapshot bug fix, use the official ARIA snapshot documentation to verify that button entries include their accessible names; this directly verifies the affected documented behavior. Stop only after the final answer includes the release metadata, the three release-note changes, and that official-documentation verification. Do not sign in. Do not create issues, comments, pull requests, or file changes.
